components.name: Constellation AG
components.refuses: Refuses authority that is already spent or no longer current. Does not execute work or treat a provider response as permission.
components.role: Decides whether one exact piece of automated work may run, and grants permission for that one run.
components.role_detail: Makes bounded, one-use authorization decisions from current inputs.
components.use: Use for the documented exact-work authorization boundary. Start with the alpha.6 composition when you need the qualified end-to-end local-copy example.

components.availability: Public source; released profiles pin their own revisions, including alpha.2 saved checks, alpha.4 local-successor replay, alpha.5 installed-cadence exercise, and alpha.6 bounded observation admission. The archive/rollover procedure is a source-level operator path, not an installed recurring migration. NQ 0.2.0 is also published as a component package (a Debian package and a tarball) for NQ alone: https://github.com/unpingable/constellation-nq/releases/tag/v0.2.0.
components.maturity: Developer preview. Public examples cover saved checks, maintenance annotations, replay, local-inbox delivery and alpha.6 evidence admission. Archive/rollover is separately qualified in disposable state; production migration, transparent cross-store lookup, restoration, rollback and live Slack/Discord delivery remain unverified.
components.name: Constellation NQ
components.refuses: Returns a typed refusal when required evidence is missing, stale or cannot be evaluated. Its results never authorize an effect.
components.role: Evaluates a narrowly defined question from recorded evidence.
components.role_detail: Derives bounded diagnostic dispositions or typed refusals from retained evidence.
components.use: Use a named diagnostic profile or retain a bounded local SQLite check. The five compiled diagnostic profiles and local saved-check interface are distinct; neither establishes general health or permission to act.

components.availability: Public source. Alpha.6 pins fbcacc1dfb95f0f625a72e123f61afa41c1ddccb for its bounded local permission snapshot, attempt custody, dispatch, settlement and reconciliation.
components.maturity: Supported executor contracts, an operationally reusable Git-effect vertical, and one qualified alpha.6 local-copy workflow; not production-hardened.
components.name: Constellation Docket
components.refuses: Refuses to execute without matching, current permission. An uncertain attempt is recorded as indeterminate and reconciled, not blindly repeated.
components.role: Keeps custody of one authorized execution attempt: dispatches it, records the outcome and reconciles it.
components.role_detail: Keeps custody of a bounded execution attempt and records its outcome.
components.use: Use when an authorized workflow needs attempt identity and settlement custody.

components.availability: Public source. Alpha.6 pins cycle runtime 9e592cbe581c24b3973677ef3938bccac4feea49 and Foreman 58639a9bfe8ddf3d6b232aab6dc231dcf82b6769; the later public lineage reader is e7c35db3ad6ce7cd53e280e6be118b042d89f63b.
components.maturity: Development source. Saved-check recurrence, maintenance-aware attention, replay, local delivery and one actual alpha.6 occurrence/review path are exercised. No production recurring installation or complete consumer migration is claimed.
components.name: Constellation Nightshift
components.refuses: Does not authorize or execute work, and does not turn old evidence into a fresh fact.
components.role: Tracks recurring work and changing conditions over time, and proposes the next bounded task.
components.role_detail: Tracks currentness, recurrence, and attention over time.
components.use: Use when a workflow needs temporal observation rather than authorization or execution.

components.name: Maude

components.role_detail: Authors, checks, compares, and locks pre-governed plans.

components.refuses: Read-only: cannot accept a plan, grant authority, rerun work or settle an occurrence.
components.role: Shows authored goals with their linked runs, outcomes and supporting records.
components.role_detail: Shows authored goals and their linked runs, outcomes, and supporting records.
components.use: Inspect exact authored-plan and run relationships without changing owner state. A settled or successful attempt does not establish objective completion.

components.maturity: Supported in a continuity-aware vertical; broader trajectory doctrine remains candidate.

components.use: Use when a workflow requires an independently custodied mandate lifecycle.

components.name: Constellation Linear Accountant
components.refuses: Accounts for capacity only; it does not authorize action.
components.role: Tracks finite resource allowances and prevents double spending.
components.role_detail: Accounts for conserved finite capacity separately from action permission.
